tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje 'chang sogs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*// rgyud bzhi'i yi dam gtso bo 'khor lo sdom// zag med bde ster rdo rje phag mo yi// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rab 'byams phyag gi yul// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul rnams kun gyi gtso// dpal chen 'khor lo sdom pa'i pho brang mchog /lha mi 'gro ba kun gyi phyag mchod rten// dag pa'i zhig mchog dpal gyi tsā rir bdud//

tsā ri yul smad kyi gnas bstod mkha' 'gro'i dril chung zhes bya ba/ na mo gu ruḥtsakra saṃ bha ra ya/ yab bde chan he ru ka dpal dang*// yum chos dbyings rdo rje phag mo yi// zhabs spyi bor bkod de phyag bgyis pas// bdag rang rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// dus de ring tsā ri yul smad ces// ma mkha' 'gro'i gnas la mos gus kyi// bstod pa'i dbyangs zhig len lags na// mdzes pa'i snyan gyis gsan du gsol// g.yas dpa' bo'i tshogs kyi seng ge'i sgra// ngan bu yi glu la ram 'degs mdzod// g.yon ma dang mkha' 'gro'i 'gying bag gis// rol pa'i gar stabs brtsen par mdzod// gnas tsā ri tra la grong sde lnga*// de'i nang nas yul smad ces bya ba// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i sgrub gnas kyi// khyad chos snying nas bsngags par 'dod// dpal gnyos mgar chos gsum rgya ras kyis// gnas sgo mo phye bar byon dus su// sa'i dbyibs ni rdo rje phag mo yum// gan rkyal du gzim pa 'dra ba gzigs// gnas spur chen gyi ri bo brjid pa der// spur chen dpa' bo'i ri bo dang*// spur chung dpa' mo'i ri zhes pa// mthong grol gyi ri bo mdzes pa yod// ri'i logs na shin tu gsal ba ni// dpa' bo rdo yi thod pa zhes// de'i nang du zhi rgyas dbang drag gi// yi dam gyi lha yi dkyil 'khor yod// der brag ri mchod rten 'dra ba yi// ri sna mchod kong dang 'dra ba der// yum a ma la ang gin mched gsum mam// yum dri med gzugs can rnam gsum bzhugs// ri de yi rtse mo ngosayangs la// phrin las kyi bdud rtsi'i mtsho bzhi 'khyil// ri bo 'di bde mchog yab yum gyi// lha'i pho brang gzhal yas khang chen yin// dus bzang po drug pa tshes bzhi la// rang yul tsā ri'i skye bo dang*// phyogs gzhan gyi skal ldan las 'phro can// gnas skor ba ma lus 'di ru 'dzoms// de'i 'gram na gzi chen gsang phug dang*// rta mgrin gyi dbu rtse'i ri logs su// rta mgrin dang phag mo yab yum gyi// gnas mchog gyur mgi gi dga' ston yod// de'i g.yon du 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gnas// ma rgyal yum sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi// pho brang mig gis mthong tsam gyis// yid dad pa'i myu gu bskyed pa yod// de'i 'og na lde'u g.yag la zhes// la steng du dngosagrub bam ro yod// de mthong thos dran pas sangs rgyas pa// bram ze skye ba bdun pa yi// sku gdung gi bam ro yin zhes gsung*// dus tshes bzang dang ni dus bzang la// bam ro des 'khun pa'i skad 'byin pa// las bsod nams can gyi mi mang pos// sgra dngos su thos pa mang po byung*// nad rtsa dkar dang grib nad 'gog byed pa// sba gdub dang smyug tshigs bzang po'i rgyu// tsā ri yi smyug ma byin rlabs can// ri 'di yi logs nas zhu ba yin// gnas de na bkra shis brtsegs pa'i ri// rnam sras kyi bang mdzod 'dra ba'i nang*// bka' mdo sngags kyi chos kyi gter chen po// ri 'di yi khong du sbas nas yod// yul smad dbus kyi thang dkyil na// ri tshogs dang nu 'bur 'dra ba yod// bde ster nu 'bur gyi ri de la// mkha' 'gro 'bum thim zhes su grags// gnas gser sgo gnyos mgar rgya ras sogs// pha skyes chen mang pos ri 'di la// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang ma mkha' 'gro// bye ba 'bum ther thim pa gzigs// yul nyer bzhi'i ya gyal gnas 'di ni// mthong ba'am yid la dran pas kyang*// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum dang*// ma mkha' 'gros rjes su 'dzin zhes gsungs// 'dir bdud rtsi klu yi chu mig dang*// rang byung rdza yi mchod rten sogs// rten ngo mtshar can grangs med yod na yang*// mi phal pa'i blo ru chud pa dka'// der rin chen brag ṛ gseng dbar nas// yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu rgyun ni// lha yi dar dkar brkyangs 'dra ba// sgra snyan po sgrog cing 'bab pa yod// dpyid nam zla shar dus bya byi'us// gnas bzangagi bstod pa'i glu dbyangs len// dbyar lang tsho rgyas dus ri klung kun// me tog gi gos kyi klubs nas sdod// gnas bangaza po dag pa shrī dpal// tsā ri tra yi bkod pa la// snyan tshig gis bstod nas glu len pa// ma mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i mchod pa yin// tshul 'di la 'bad pa'i dge ba yis// gnas mchog 'dir mos gus dad ldan gyis// skal ldan gyi skyes bu ma lus pa// lam zab mo'i rtogasapa rnyed par shog

lus lhan skyes bde bas tshim pa dang*// ngag mkha' 'gro'i glu dang mi 'bral zhing*// yid bde stong mchog la mnga' brnyes te// ma 'gro ba 'dren pa mchog gyur shog ༄༅/// /༈'khor lo sdom pa bde mchog dag pa yi shel rir// rtse gcig mos gus dad pas gsol ba zhig btabs te// ngo mtshar gnas mchog tsā ri'i bshad pa 'di brjod par// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gnang ba zhig stsol cig// /smon tshig/ gangs can grub pa rnams kyi dka' thub gzhi// tsā ri tra zhes phyogs kayi gzhon nu mas// snyan pa'i ba dan bsgreng ba'i gnas mchog der// 'grod pa'i skal bzang ldan pa'i skyes bu'i ched/ 1 /gnas yig phyogs bsdus lam gsal sgron me 'di// lhag bsam dag pa'i dpung pas nyer bstegs te// rang nus 'bad pas bskrun pa'i legs bayas las// rnam dkar 'bras bu gang zhig 'thob gyur na/ 2 /de yis yid can spyi dang gnas mchog la// phyag mchod bskor ba'i dad ldan skyes bu dang*// lhag par bdag la drin du che ba'i pha// dkon mchog lhun grub dang ni drin can ma/ 3 /tshe ring sgrol ma bsam 'grub lha mo sogs// las dang smon pas 'brel ba'i skye 'gro kun// bde nas bde ba'i lam bzang myur 'grod de// byang chen go 'phang dam par reg par shog /khyad par 'gro kun he ruḥka dpal dang*// yum chen phag mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// mnyes bzhin rjes su bzung ste phyag rgya che'i// lam bzang mngon du gyur pa'i rgyu ru smon/// /
